annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "sleep" on page 563 ("The Bedroom Scene"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within HCE and ALP in bed, the children's cries, attempted sexual intercourse, domestic reality intruding on the cosmic dream. During this Age of Men (closing) phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish

annotations.annotation_text: Fraternal archetype "Jerry" on page 563 ("The Bedroom Scene"): the opposing sons — Shem the Penman (introvert artist, tree, darkness) and Shaun the Post (extrovert politician, stone, light) — manifest here within HCE and ALP in bed, the children's cries, attempted sexual intercourse, domestic reality intruding on the cosmic dream. Their Brunonian dialectic of coinciding opposites propels the chapter's conflict during this Age of Men (closing) phase.
sources: Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
Norris, Margot. The Decentered Universe of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/decentereduniver0000norr

annotations.annotation_text: The Letter motif "letter" on page 563 ("The Bedroom Scene"): ALP's mysterious document — scratched from the midden by Biddy Doran the Hen — represents the genesis of all writing within HCE and ALP in bed, the children's cries, attempted sexual intercourse, domestic reality intruding on the cosmic dream. During this Age of Men (closing) phase, the letter functions simultaneously as archaeological artifact, love note, legal deposition, and the text of Finnegans Wake itself.
